**Role Overview:** 




 Options market making presents a unique challenge in combining massive scale with complex financial workflows. Every day, Citadel Securities processes billions of market events across more than a million listed options while delivering pricing, execution, and risk management with extremely low latency.
 



  





 The Options Trading Workflow Team builds the applications and services that power how traders price, manage, and execute options trading strategies. We develop the next generation of high\-touch trading and pricing tools that sit at the intersection of sophisticated backend systems and intuitive user experiences, enabling traders to make faster, smarter decisions in real time.
 



  





 This role offers the opportunity to work directly with the hiring manager on a new global OTC Options initiative supporting Citadel Securities' Institutional Derivatives, PSG, and Structured Products businesses. You'll help define the technology strategy for new products and workflows while building systems that enable the firm to expand into new markets and option instruments around the world.
 



  





 If you're excited by solving challenging distributed systems problems while creating high\-performance user experiences that directly impact trading, this is an opportunity to shape the future of one of the world's leading market makers.
 



  





*Opportunities may be available from time to time in any location in which the business is based for suitable candidates. If you are interested in a career with Citadel, please share your details and we will contact you if there is a vacancy available.* 




**Responsibilities:** 



* Help define and build the next generation of high\-touch pricing and trading workflow tools for Options traders.
* Partner directly with traders, quantitative researchers, sales teams, and business leaders to design workflows that improve pricing, execution, and risk management.
* Build full stack applications spanning modern web frontends, backend services, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Develop intuitive, high\-performance user interfaces that enable traders to research, monitor, price, and execute trades in real time.
* Design scalable backend services that support pricing, workflow orchestration, market data, and trading operations.
* Build systems to support markets and option instruments Citadel Securities has never traded before.
* Gain exposure to multiple global markets while helping expand Citadel Securities' Options platform internationally.
* Prototype new ideas quickly while evolving them into robust production systems.
* Analyze complex business and technical problems and deliver elegant software solutions across the firm.
* Continuously improve performance, scalability, stability, and usability of mission\-critical trading applications.
* Collaborate across engineering, quantitative research, and trading teams to translate complex financial concepts into intuitive software.

* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building complex applications.
* Strong experience building full stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Proficiency with TypeScript and React

* Experience building distributed systems and service\-oriented architectures.

**Why This Role Is Unique** 



* Define the next generation of high\-touch pricing technology used by Options traders globally.
* Work on a greenfield global OTC Options initiative with significant visibility across the business.
